{{Quote|What kind of insects? If they look like worms with legs&mdash;''"<br />"''It's no shockapede hive. These are flitnats, completely harmless.|Jacen Solo and Jovan Drark|<ref name="Star by Star" />}}
'''Shockapedes''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insect/Legends|insect]] used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] that resembled [[Worm/Legends|worms]] with [[Limb/Legends|legs]]. They resided in hives and were known to be dangerous.<ref name="Star by Star" />

When the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jovan Drark]] discovered an insect nest while attempting to repair and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] that the [[Myrkr strike team]] found on the Yuuzhan Vong [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]] ''[[Baanu Rass]]'' during their [[Mission to Myrkr|mission]] to eliminate the [[Voxyn queen]], [[Gender/Legends|his]] fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] inquired if the creatures looked like worms with legs over [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Drark, who was also familiar familiar with shockapedes, assured Solo that it was not a shockapede hive, but a nest of [[flitnat]]s.<ref name="Star by Star" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shockapedes were first mentioned in the [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Star by Star" />
